text: The correct co-inventor is Katharine B. Blodgett, not Irving Langmuir, as she was the woman scientist who worked with Schaefer at General Electric and pioneered thin film coatings. The patent for the "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" (U.S. Patent 2,536,884) lists both Vincent Joseph Schaefer and Katharine B. Blodgett as inventors in 1947. CONFIDENCE: 100
